basic_details.job_title: ECHS BD Bari Nursing Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Station HQ (ECHS Cell), BD Bari, under the Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) of the Ministry of Defence, has invited applications for one Nursing Assistant to be engaged on contract at ECHS Polyclinic BD Bari for the period up to 31 March 2027. The post carries a fixed remuneration of Rs. 36,500 and requires a BSc Nursing degree with at least three years' experience. Preference is given to ex-servicemen.

important_dates.interview_date: 27 October 2026, 8:30 AM at Station HQ BD Bari

selection_process: Selection is by interview on 27 October 2026. The notice does not describe any written test or skill test. Candidates are expected to meet the qualification and experience requirement before applying; original documents are checked at the interview.
how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application format from the ECHS website, echs.gov.in. The notice says the format, terms and conditions, and remuneration details are all on the website.
Fill in the form and attach self-attested photocopies of your educational qualification and work experience documents.
Prepare two complete sets; the notice requires submission in duplicate.
Submit both sets to the OIC, ECHS Cell, Station HQ BD Bari between 9:00 AM and 2:00 PM, on or before 21 October 2026.
Applications received after the due date and time will not be accepted.

The notice describes submission at the ECHS Cell during fixed hours and does not mention postal applications. If you cannot deliver in person, confirm with the cell first on 01923-295613 or at [email protected].
The window closes at 2:00 PM on 21 October, not at the end of the day.
Keep a third copy of the complete application for your own records.
Read the ECHS terms and conditions on the website before applying; the notice relies on them for age limit, remuneration rules and contract conditions it does not spell out.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Qualification: BSc Nursing. Experience: a minimum of three years. The notice does not specify the type of institution; carry experience certificates that state the role and the period served. Preference: ex-servicemen are given preference. Civilian candidates can apply but rank behind eligible ex-servicemen with the same qualification. Age: the notice does not state an age limit. ECHS's standard terms and conditions for contractual staff are on echs.gov.in and should be read before applying. The notice states that only candidates who meet the qualitative requirement should apply, so applications from candidates without a BSc Nursing degree or with less than three years' experience are unlikely to be called for interview.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Remuneration: Rs. 36,500, described in the notice as fixed remuneration. Details of remuneration and other terms are on the ECHS website. Tenure: the engagement runs up to 31 March 2027 and is subject to the candidate's performance and the other conditions in the ECHS terms. That is about five months from the interview date, so treat this as a short-term contract rather than a standing post. Nature of engagement: contractual, under the ECHS terms and conditions published on echs.gov.in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a BSc Nursing qualification along with a minimum of three years of experience.

faq.answer: The fixed remuneration for the Nursing Assistant post is 36,500.
